message: v10.7.8 adds a Sandbox rule for Unlimited Datacenter Serving Capacity. Sandbox training compute can remain infinite while serving capacity can either be unlimited or come only from the datacenters, accelerator generation, custom silicon and leased compute actually built by the player. Manual serving mode uses the full serving-capacity limits from v10.7.7, including subscription blocking and overload pressure, while unlimited mode now displays clean infinity values instead of artificial trillion-PF/token numbers. The Datacenters page also shows the real physical Sandbox fleet separately from infinite training compute. Existing v10.7.7 serving economics, optimization, rival cyber damage, difficulty rebalance, licensing and human-voice tutorial remain included.
